NDT software in Hamilton, Ontario: made for steel city inspection

An NDT company in Hamilton needs software that keeps up with mill shutdowns, fabrication shop volume and structural steel paperwork, while keeping every technician's certificate and every instrument's calibration current. The Atlantis ERP solution is a fully customized ERP for NDT and inspection companies. It brings together reports, technician certificates, equipment calibration, crew dispatch, quoting and invoicing, and it is set up and supported by Atlantis NDT, whose founder is an ASNT NDT Level III.

Hamilton's inspection work is shaped by steel. ArcelorMittal Dofasco and the Stelco Hamilton works line the bay, and around them is a dense supply chain: structural and plate fabricators, machine shops, crane and rigging firms, galvanizers, and heavy equipment rebuilders across Stoney Creek, Burlington, Ancaster and the Niagara Peninsula. The Port of Hamilton handles steel, bulk cargo and agri-food, and there are bridges and highway structures from the Skyway to the escarpment crossings. Out of that come a few recurring types of work: MT and UT on crane runways, ladles, rolls and shafts during mill outages; UT and MT on welds in CWB-certified fabrication shops; UT thickness and hardness on wear parts; and VT and UT on structures for owners and engineers.

Much of it arrives at short notice. A mill line goes down and a crew is needed tonight, or a fabricator's shipment date moves forward and every weld needs checking by Friday. The sections below apply each Atlantis ERP app to that Hamilton pattern.

ERP for NDT companies in Hamilton: which apps matter

An ERP for NDT companies in Hamilton should link the call-out, the crew, the kit, the report and the invoice so nothing gets lost between the mill gate and the office. The Atlantis ERP is built from apps designed for inspection companies.

  • Team Assignments: dispatch from planned to closed, availability calendar, and blocking of double-booked technicians and equipment serials. This is critical when a mill outage and a shop rush land in the same week.
  • NDT Reports: 17 report types, including UT, MT, PT, VT, PAUT, TOFD, UT thickness, hardness, PMI, ferrite and RT, each with its own numbering sequence.
  • Certificates: every technician certificate, vision test and exam sheet, with automatic status and expiry alerts.
  • Asset Management: yokes, flaw detectors, probes, hardness testers and thickness gauges by serial number, with calibration register and issue/return approval.
  • Quotations, Invoicing and Timesheets: NDT-aware quotes and invoices, and time split by inspection, travel, standby and setup.

Add Project, CRM, Fleet, Purchase, Inventory, Expenses and Dashboards as you need them. Full list at /erp/apps.

Crew dispatch software for mill outages and shop call-outs

Crew dispatch software for a Hamilton NDT company has to handle planned mill outages, which are booked weeks ahead, alongside same-day shop calls. Team Assignments treats each job as an assignment that moves through planned, dispatched, in field, submitted and closed, with calendar, kanban and list views.

For each assignment you record the site's GPS coordinates and the mobilisation and demobilisation dates. That helps when a steel plant has several gates and a crew needs to find the right melt shop or rolling mill entrance at 5 a.m. The availability calendar covers assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable days, blocks overlaps, and pulls in approved Time Off automatically.

For every technician the planner sees status, current assignment, utilisation and next available date. So when a fabricator calls asking for a Level II in UT for three days next week, the answer comes from the system, not from phoning around. Two checks protect you:

  • A technician or an equipment serial number cannot be booked onto two overlapping jobs.
  • If the assigned yoke, flaw detector or hardness tester is out of calibration, the planner is warned before it leaves the shop.

Project records hold the safety induction and work permit fields that steel plants insist on, so you know which technicians have completed a mill's contractor orientation and which still need it. The Fleet app assigns trucks to projects and drivers with dates and mileage, and records which vehicles can carry radioactive sources, with transport licence number and expiry.

Technician certification tracking for Hamilton crews

Technician certification tracking software in Hamilton needs to show, per method and level, who is qualified for which job. The Atlantis Certificates app records scheme, level, method, certifying body, issue, expiry and renewal dates, industry sector, OJT and training hours, exam results and attachments, and it computes the status automatically: active, expiring soon, expired or revoked.

Most Hamilton technicians hold CGSB certification through NRCan's ISO 9712 program, particularly in MT and UT, because steel producers and structural engineers in Ontario commonly specify it. Companies that also serve US clients, or US-owned plants, add employer certification under SNT-TC-1A. Many fabrication-focused technicians also hold CWB welding inspector certification to CSA W178.2. That can be recorded under the "other" scheme with its own dates and certificate file, so a fabricator's QC audit for CSA W47.1 can see your inspectors' qualifications in one place.

  • Vision tests: near vision (Jaeger J1/J2), far vision, colour perception and contrast, with examiner, clinic and expiry. This matters for MT and PT, where colour contrast judgement is the whole job.
  • Examination sheets: general, specific and practical scores against a passing score, with exam files attached.
  • Certificate templates per scheme: validity in months, whether a vision test or exam is required, and minimum OJT and training hours.
  • Daily checks create warning tasks 90 days before expiry. Configurable emails reach the right supervisors, and Timesheets warn if someone logs time on an invalid cert.

Atlantis delivers NDT training based on ASNT SNT-TC-1A only. The ERP records ISO 9712, PCN and CSWIP certificates, but Atlantis does not train for those schemes.

NDT reporting software for steel mills and fabricators

NDT reporting software for Hamilton work must be fast enough for a fabricator's shipping deadline and detailed enough for a mill's reliability engineer. The Atlantis NDT Reports app records method-specific data and takes every report through draft, in progress, review, approved and sent, signed by the inspector, reviewer and approver.

Typical Hamilton use:

  • Fabrication shops. UT and MT reports with weld and job lines, defect type and orientation, and an overall result of acceptable, not acceptable or acceptable with remarks. WPS, drawing and contract references tie each weld to the shop drawing the engineer approved.
  • Mill outages. MT technique and particle type for crane runway girders, crane hooks, ladle trunnions and structural members; UT with the probe calibration table for shafts, pins and rolls; UT thickness readings by direction on chutes, ducts and stacks.
  • Material checks. Hardness and PMI reports for replacement components and weld repairs, and ferrite reports for stainless work.
  • Weld quality on thicker sections. PAUT with focal laws and TOFD where the client prefers them to radiography.

Versioned company templates in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML carry your logo and layout. If a big fabricator or a mill wants its own Excel sheet, fields are mapped to cells and filled automatically. The offline field app keeps working inside steel buildings where mobile signal is poor, stores drafts and photos, and syncs later. For owners who want structural or equipment condition shown in 3D, see Atlantis Digital Twins.

Calibration management software for Hamilton instruments and consumables

Calibration management software for a Hamilton NDT company has to keep up with equipment that takes a beating. Yokes get dropped, probe faces wear quickly on hot or scaled steel, and hardness testers get knocked around in shop carts. In Asset Management, every item is tracked by serial number with assigned person, condition, asset tag, firmware, accessories and lifecycle status: new, active, in calibration, in repair, rented out, retired or disposed.

Calibration records store the provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag, result (pass, fail or conditional) and next due date. The certificate register keeps the lab's accreditation number and the PDF, with valid, expiring and expired status and email alerts. Yoke lift checks and similar routine verifications can be logged in the maintenance record so the history sits with the instrument.

The issue/return workflow, with supervisor and manager approval and condition recorded at each end, shows exactly which crew returned a damaged probe. Reservations prevent two supervisors from promising the same PAUT unit to two clients, and inbound and outbound movements are logged. The maintenance log covers preventive, corrective, repair, cleaning, firmware updates and probe replacement, with condition before and after.

Consumables such as MT powders and wet-method ink, contrast paint, penetrant kits, couplant and PPE have reorder levels and low-stock flags, so a night crew isn't sent out without white contrast paint. The Purchase app records vendor types (OEM, dealer, calibration lab), the lab's accreditation status and expiry, and links purchase lines to a specific equipment serial.

Procedures and quality evidence for Hamilton audits

Hamilton clients audit hard. Steel producers audit contractors, fabricators are audited by CWB and by engineers, and your own ISO 9001 registrar comes round every year. The Procedures app keeps a controlled register: document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard (for example ASME Section V, AWS D1.1 or the relevant CSA standard), acceptance criteria, and body text or uploaded file.

The workflow runs from draft to submitted, reviewed, approved and published, and also handles rejection with a reason, and archiving. Prepared, reviewed and approved by are recorded with dates, approved revisions are locked, and every revision keeps a snapshot. When a structural engineer asks which revision of the MT procedure your inspector used on a particular girder, you have the answer. Approvers get email notifications and reminders. The AI-assisted first draft gives your Level III a starting point for new procedures, which the Level III then reviews and approves.

NCR and CAPA workflows can be set up during implementation, turning a rejected weld report or an audit finding into a tracked action with an owner and a due date. Company certifications such as ISO 9001 are held with their own alert days. For regulatory context, boilers and pressure vessels in Ontario fall under TSSA and radiography sources under the CNSC. The ERP keeps your records in order for those regimes but does not stand in for them.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Hamilton jobs

NDT quoting and invoicing software should match how Hamilton work is actually bought: outage packages, blanket POs from fabricators and one-off call-outs. Quotations carry job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, allow a global discount, and use NDT service products flagged by method and category. The client gets a branded PDF, accepts and signs online, and the quote becomes a sales order.

Invoicing puts the NDT project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector in the header, with labour, equipment and consumables subtotals. Lines can show cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, rate type and days or hours. Steel producers usually require invoices that match their PO line items and contractor time records exactly. Mapping your invoice to their structure is done during implementation.

Timesheets record inspection, travel, standby and setup separately, with a billable flag, rate multiplier for nights and weekends, site, client and equipment serial, and supervisor approval. During an outage, hours spent waiting for lockout or for a crane to clear are captured as standby rather than lost. Ontario HST and payment terms are configured at setup. Expenses captures field costs and re-bills them. The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA and outstanding invoices across twelve months, so you can compare mill work against shop work.

Inspection management software in Hamilton: growth and visibility

Inspection management software in Hamilton should also help you spread your client base beyond one or two big steel accounts. The CRM records service line, lead source, NDT service type, industry sector, site country, and estimated technicians and days, and scores each lead from 0 to 100 as hot, warm, nurture or cold.

Import a list of Golden Horseshoe fabricators from CSV, preview AI-personalised emails, and enrol contacts in drip sequences by service line. AI Marketing drafts newsletters and announcements using a model that can run on your own server. Business Cards reads a card photographed at a local industry event and creates the lead in one click. Website enquiry forms feed the CRM, and Surveys collect client feedback after each job.

Dashboards show calibration due and overdue, certs expiring and expired, and issued equipment overdue for return, next to financial KPIs. Owners get a morning view of whether the company is audit-ready. The open REST API connects to QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Maximo or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation. That is useful if a steel client wants work orders passed electronically.

Implementing the Atlantis ERP in Hamilton

We plan a Hamilton rollout around your outage calendar and your biggest shop clients.

  1. Discovery. Methods, clients, report formats, certification schemes, CWB-related documents and how dispatch runs today.
  2. Data load. Technicians, certs, vision tests, instruments and calibration history, consumables, clients and sites.
  3. Dispatch and timesheets. Planners and supervisors move onto Team Assignments, and technicians book time from their phones.
  4. Reports. Company and client templates are rebuilt, and crews start on the offline field app.
  5. Quoting and invoicing. PO mapping, HST and invoice layouts are set up, plus any integration.
  6. Support. Atlantis NDT helps as you add CRM, Fleet or eLearning.

If you bring on apprentices, eLearning hosts Level I to III course sections, protected video lessons, quizzes and completion certificates, and the Practical NDT 3D simulator lets trainees practise before they touch a live girder. Book a Hamilton ERP demo using your own MT and UT reports.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best NDT software for a Hamilton inspection company?

Choose software that combines reports, certifications, calibration, dispatch and billing. The Atlantis ERP does that and is configured for the steel mill and fabrication work that dominates Hamilton.

Can it record CWB welding inspector certifications?

Yes. CWB certifications can be stored under the "other" scheme with level, dates, attachments and expiry alerts, next to CGSB ISO 9712 and SNT-TC-1A certs.

Will it stop an out-of-calibration yoke going to site?

The planner is warned when assigned equipment is out of calibration, and the same serial cannot be booked onto two overlapping jobs.

Does the field app work inside steel buildings?

Yes. It works offline, stores drafts and photos on the device and syncs when signal returns.

Can it integrate with our accounting software?

Yes. The open REST API connects with QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Maximo or any system that accepts API connections, scoped during implementation.

How is it priced?

Quote on request, based on the apps and configuration you choose. Ask for a Hamilton quote.

Does Atlantis train technicians?

Atlantis offers NDT training based on ASNT SNT-TC-1A only. It does not deliver ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP or API training, but the ERP records those certificates.
